lines.text: Living cells obey the same laws of energy as engines. The first law says energy is conserved; the second
law says every energy transfer increases the entropy of the universe. Cells stay ordered by releasing heat.
Free energy tells us which reactions can run on their own. A reaction with a negative change in Gibbs free
energy (written as delta G < 0) is spontaneous, while ATP hydrolysis drives reactions that are not.
